reconstruction.key_write_identity: With norm(k)=1 and delta update Snew=S+beta*(v-Sk)k^T, Snew*k=(1-beta)Sk+beta*v. For q orthogonal to k, Snew*q=S*q. This is conditional state-space protection, not protection against changes of learned keys/weights.
reconstruction.two_key_counterexample: StartS=0,beta1=beta2=1,k0^Tk1=c. After storingv0 at k0 thenv1 at k1: S2*k0=(1-c*c)*v0+c*v1. c=0 preserves both, c=1 overwritesfirst. Merely selecting delta rule doesnotlearnkey separation.
